mainEntity.name: What is the difference between general SEO and GEO (local) SEO for a med spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: General SEO focuses on improving a website's overall visibility in national or global search results for broad keywords. GEO (local) SEO, however, specifically targets clients within a defined geographic area. For a med spa, local SEO prioritizes appearing in searches like 'botox near me' or 'med spa [city name]', optimizing your Google Business Profile, and building local citations, whereas general SEO might focus on broader informational content that isn't location-dependent.
acceptedAnswer.description: General SEO aims for broad visibility, while GEO (local) SEO for med spas targets local clients within a specific geographic area, focusing on 'near me' searches and local listings.
